description: A deep Q-learning agent with a movable noise-free attention spotlight learned to catch a falling ball when it had a 10 by 10 descriptive attention schema. Disabling the schema after training, or withholding it from the start, greatly reduced performance or learning.
limitations: A small three-layer network and a simple square spotlight, tested over 150,000 training games. A larger agent, or more training, might learn without the schema.

sources.quote: If the attention schema was removed before learning began, the agent was impaired at learning.
